tagline.en: Vchitect-2.0's Apache-2.0 text-to-video model, a compact 2B run natively through WorldFoundry's shared diffusion pipeline.
tagline.zh: Vchitect-2.0 采用 Apache-2.0 许可的文生视频模型，一个紧凑的 2B，通过 WorldFoundry 统一扩散 pipeline 原生运行。

en: Vchitect-2.0 T2V is an open text-to-video model from the Vchitect project, released under Apache-2.0. It turns a text prompt into a generated video clip.

The 2B model is built from role-based diffusion components — a DiT denoiser, a text conditioner, a scheduler, a latent initializer, and an SD3-style decoder. In WorldFoundry these are assembled natively and run on the shared diffusion pipeline.
In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — point at the checkpoint, give it a prompt, and it writes out a video.
zh: Vchitect-2.0 T2V 是 Vchitect 项目开源的文生视频模型，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。它可以把一段文字提示词生成为视频片段。
这个 2B 模型由角色化的扩散组件构成——DiT 去噪器、文本条件器、调度器、latent 初始化器与 SD3 风格解码器。在 WorldFoundry 中，它们被原生组装并跑在统一扩散 pipeline 上。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline 运行它——指向 checkpoint，给它提示词，它就会输出一段视频。

whenToUse.en: A good openly-licensed choice when you want a compact 2B text-to-video model to prototype with, under a permissive Apache-2.0 license.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个紧凑的 2B 文生视频模型做原型、并希望采用宽松的 Apache-2.0 许可时，它是不错的开放选择。

notFor.en: Image-to-video or animating an existing image — this route is text-to-video. Weights are downloaded separately, so plan for the download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 不适合图生视频或让已有图片动起来——该路径是文生视频。权重需单独下载，请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。

en: Role-based DiT with an SD3-style decoder, run natively
zh: 紧凑的 2B 文生视频模型
角色化 DiT 搭配 SD3 风格解码器，原生运行
